correctness.rationale: The graph-cover equivalence is exact for lax split semantics; two disjoint edges plus cross-cover breakers prove a four-edge obstruction. Minimal 3-edge cases are exactly matchings. König’s theorem and degrees 2+2 force five distinct 4-edge types. Direct enumeration and double-count-free combinatorial choices prove the closed complete-grid formulas. A standalone checker confirms all 65536 graphs of size 4 by 4 and counts for every smaller complete rectangle. Finite tests are not used as a proof for arbitrary sizes.
